subject.title: All LLM API calls time out simultaneously despite APIs being reachable (multi-agent concurrency issue)

question: Should the remaining work be driven by a canonical current-main four-agent Telegram/provider live repro, split into narrower runtime/provider/Telegram issues, or closed only after proving the merged mitigations eliminate the original timeout pattern?
rationale: The report crosses Telegram ingress, provider transport, model fallback, run-budget timeout, and launch/default surfaces, and automation cannot safely choose a permanent owner boundary from partial mitigations alone.

options.title: Require canonical live repro
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a current-main four-agent Telegram trace before choosing a code or config change.

options.title: Split narrower bottleneck issues
options.body: Move remaining work into specific runtime, provider transport, or Telegram concurrency issues if maintainers decide this report is too broad to own directly.

options.title: Close after mitigation proof
options.body: Close only if a comparable current-main live run shows the all-provider timeout pattern no longer occurs.

recommendation.title: Require canonical live repro
